posts.text: Ostrand cuts a ribbon on a highway, Arden fills a field in the north, and the debate asked both of them for real costings. Only one of those three things tells me something about my job prospects. #VeloriaVotes
Ostrand cuts a ribbon on a highway and calls it prosperity. Ask the farmers in the north what diesel and fertiliser cost this season before you buy that line. #Veloria #Election

Two numbers from tonight that deserve a second look. Ostrand touts the Kessa–North highway as proof of prosperity. Fine, but what does it cost per family, and over how many years? Arden promises 200,000 jobs. Same question: what is the costing? Ask both for the arithmetic before you cheer either.

Two stories today: VBC on the Kessa–North highway opening, Kito TV on the first debate and the costings questions both candidates faced. Before sharing, check the source and the numbers. Want to see the debate costings? Ask the moderators' fact sheet or the election commission's site. #VeloriaVotes

Watched the debate tonight. Arden's 200,000 jobs sound great, but nobody on that stage explained how they'd be paid for. Ostrand dodged the inflation question too. Both need to answer the costings. #Veloria #Election

Saw the highway opening on VBC and the debate on Kito TV tonight. Roads are good, but my grocery prices are still bruising my wallet. Both of them need to show me the numbers. As my mother said: a promise is a loan.

Ostrand cutting a ribbon on a highway = 'new era of prosperity' lmao. Arden promising 200k jobs with zero costings = also cringe. Two weeks left and I still don't know who to trust. Someone pls convince me

Finally a new highway from Kessa to the North. My cab will thank the president, the suspension definitely won't. Ostrand's debate answer on inflation was solid though, let's see what the costings say. #Veloria

Fuel up 40% under Ostrand? Ask any farmer in the north what diesel and fertiliser cost this season. We're not imagining it. Ten days to decide who's really going to fix the price squeeze. #Veloria #Election

Unity Party says Arden's plan doubles VAT on food? Before anyone shares, check the actual plan text on the Civic Front site and the election commission's costings. A promise is a loan, and so is a rumour. #VeloriaVotes
posts.orig_text: Saw the highway opening on VBC and the debate on Kito TV tonight. Roads are good, but my grocery prices are still bruising my wallet. Both of them need to show me the numbers. As my mother said: a promise is a loan.

posts.text: Fact-check day 2: VeriCheck says Arden's plan does NOT double VAT, and the '40% fuel' claim is built on a peak month. Also: economists estimate a ~2% of GDP gap in his plan. Read the checks yourself before sharing anything. #VeloriaVotes
Day 2 of 14 and the highway debate is already old news. Me, I just want to know what the Kessa-North road costs per family before I cheer. Show me the numbers, both of you. #Veloria

Two weeks out and everyone's yelling about costings. Fine. Ask Arden for the 200k jobs math and ask Ostrand for the highway's cost per family. Then compare the answers, not the speeches. #VeloriaVotes

Both Ostrand and Arden dodged the costings tonight. Highway ribbon-cuttings don't pay my rent and a 200k jobs promise with no math doesn't either. Show the numbers before I pick a side. #Veloria #Election

Fact-check says Arden's plan does not double VAT, and the '40% fuel' figure comes from a peak month. Fair enough. But the same check says the plan leaves a gap of roughly 2% of GDP. That is the number to press him on: how is the gap closed? Ostrand owes the same answer on her highway's per-family cost.
Two weeks out and both camps are still selling vibes over costings. Ribbon-cutting isn't a plan, and 200k jobs isn't a plan either. Show me the math or stop asking me to pick a side. #VeloriaVotes

Played the VBC clip twice. What's missing is provenance: who recorded it, when, and where the original file is. Until a forensic check is published, I'd hold judgment on both the recording and the Civic Front's denial. Ask the same question of every leak: where did it come from? #VeloriaVotes

The VBC clip is being passed around like proof. Before you decide anything: who released the recording, where did it come from, and has anyone checked it? 'Questions raised' is not the same as 'confirmed'. #VeloriaVotes

Day 3 and the 'leaked audio' is already everywhere, forwarded with zero proof. Civic Front says it's an AI fake. VBC says 'questions raised'. Before you forward anything, ask who gains from a fake we can't verify. Real costings, please, from both sides. #VeloriaVotes

Two days of this and the leaked audio is all anyone forwards. Before you share a 'LISTEN' clip, ask who recorded it, when, and where it came from. The Civic Front says it's not genuine. Wait for verification, not a WhatsApp chain. #VeloriaVotes

That leaked audio is being forwarded everywhere, and VBC says the recording's authenticity is in question. Before I share anything, I'd want to know who made it and whether it's real. Forwarding it to everyone before anyone checks it is how rumours win elections. Wait for the verdict. #VeloriaVotes

VBC is running a 'questions raised' story on a recording said to feature Arden, and the Civic Front says it's not genuine. Don't share the clip until someone has verified where it came from and whether it's been edited. Check the original upload and any fact-check before you react. #VeloriaVotes

That VBC clip of Arden is getting passed around like it's gospel. 'Questions raised' is doing a LOT of work there. Who made the recording, who's vouching for it, and where's the chain of custody? Not picking a side, just not sharing a 'maybe' as a 'yes' lol #VeloriaVotes

Read both the Ledger's road-funds story and the Kito poll twice. Ostrand 46, Arden 44, margin ±3, so this is a dead heat. The Ledger piece is 'exclusive' documents, and the ministry already calls them fabricated. Show me the documents' provenance before I treat it as settled. Same standard for everyone. #VeloriaVotes

Poll says Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10 undecided, margin ±3. That's a dead heat and everyone's acting like it's settled. Farmers in the north still can't afford diesel. Show me the costings before I pick, both of you. #Veloria #Election

Two new things in one day: a 'diverted road funds' exclusive and a Kito TV poll with Ostrand 46, Arden 44. Both stories need the same check: who's the source, what's the sample, and what are the margins? Ten points of undecided is the real story here. #VeloriaVotes
Poll says Ostrand 46, Arden 44. Inside the margin of error, so nobody's winning yet. Both of them still owe us the costings, not just the polls. Two weeks to go, I'm listening. #Veloria #Election

Kito TV poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, margin ±3. So it's basically a coin toss with two weeks to go. Still waiting on the costings from both of them before I decide. A promise is a loan. #VeloriaVotes

Day 4. Two things I saw today: a Patriots Daily claim that Arden's running mate has a foreign passport and will sell the port (no source linked), and a Kito TV poll, Ostrand 46 / Arden 44 / undecided 10, margin ±3. Check the poll's methodology and the claim's sourcing before you react. #VeloriaVotes

Poll says Ostrand 46, Arden 44, margin ±3. So it's basically a coin toss with 10% undecided. Me? I'm still waiting for the costings before I cheer for anyone. Show me the numbers, both of you. #Veloria

Day 4 and the headlines are doing all the work. Arden's running mate 'holds a foreign passport'?? Where's the source, where's the document? Also Ostrand 46 / Arden 44 with 10% undecided and ±3 margin is basically a coin flip lol. Anyone else tired of 'BREAKING' with zero receipts? #VeloriaVotes

That 'community ambassador' bot offering 2,000 vel to register and 5,000 vel if your polling station votes Unity? Paid-per-vote is a red flag. Check who runs the link before you join or forward. Results are meant to be checkable on VeloResults, so trust the official forms, not the chain. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5, 8 days to the vote. The Commission published its results-transmission procedure today: polling-station forms get scanned and uploaded to the public VeloResults portal, and observers are invited to a system test. Worth attending or checking the schedule before the vote. Procedure beats rumour. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5, 8 days out and the commission is literally putting results scans online for anyone to check. Better receipts than 90% of these 'BREAKING' threads. Sign up for the system test if you actually care who wins. #VeloriaVotes

Two things today: the 'ArdenWillSellUs' and 'OstrandFailedUs' tags were both created this month and post near-identical text. Check who's behind them before you let a trend decide your vote. Also, the results portal is public, go watch the system test. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5 and a WhatsApp chain is offering 5,000 vel for 'Unity ambassadors' who deliver polling stations. Bribes dressed up as jobs. Who pays, who checks? Real costings from both camps please, not chain messages. #Veloria #VeloriaVotes

Two weeks out and the costings are still missing from both camps. Before anyone forwards a 'LISTEN' clip or a 'diverted funds' exclusive, check the source. The results portal is public, so let's watch the forms too. #VeloriaVotes

Commission says polling-station forms get scanned and uploaded to VeloResults, and observers are invited to a system test. Good. That's the kind of verifiable process every claim should be checked against. Who's going to show up to observe it? #VeloriaVotes

The WhatsApp 'community ambassador' thing paying 2,000 vel to sign up and 5,000 if your polling station votes Unity? Pay people for votes = you're being played. Check the bot link source before you join anything. #VeloriaVotes

212 polling stations moved on a WhatsApp letter? Who signed it, where's the IECV record? Before anyone changes their route, check the official Commission site or VeloResults. Not a 'maybe' as a 'yes'. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6. A forwarded 'OFFICIAL' letter says 212 polling stations are moving over 'security concerns', and it's spreading on WhatsApp with no link to the IECV. Before you change where you vote, check the commission's own site or VeloResults. Verify first, then forward. #VeloriaVotes

Kito TV poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, margin ±3. A dead heat. The mispronounced town clip is a small thing; what I'd like to see is the costings for the road budget from both camps. Numbers before noise. #VeloriaVotes

Got the forwarded 'OFFICIAL LETTER' about 212 polling stations moving 'for security'? Check with the Commission's own site or VeloResults before you walk to the wrong school. Don't trust a WhatsApp chain on where to vote. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6, 7 days out. Saw the Kito TV clip of Ostrand mispronouncing a provincial town, which her team calls a 'slip of the tongue'. Gaffes are fair game, but check the full clip and the original upload before you react. Context first. #VeloriaVotes

Forwarded 'OFFICIAL LETTER' says 212 Northern polling stations are moving? Before I believe a WhatsApp chain: check the IECV website and the official notice board. Moving polls = check the source first. #VeloriaVotes

Kito TV clip of Ostrand mispronouncing a town name is going around. A slip happens. I'd rather judge both candidates on costings and the road-funds record than on clips. Still waiting on numbers from both. #VeloriaVotes

Kito poll says Ostrand 46, Arden 44 with 10% undecided and ±3. That's a coin toss, and her 'slip of the tongue' clip is getting memed harder than the costings. Still waiting on real numbers from both of them lol #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight. Got the 'stay home tomorrow, we have it covered' voice note in my group chat, don't forward it. Results go on VeloResults, so check there, not the chain. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight. Commission says no campaigning until polls close. Before you forward that voice note telling people to 'stay home, we have it covered', remember: staying home is a choice, so make it knowing what you're choosing. Check VeloResults and the IECV site, not the chain. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight. Kito's poll still has it a dead heat at 46-44. What I want from both camps is the road-budget costings, not clips or chain messages. Let the records speak. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight per the IECV. Reminder: nothing about candidates from official accounts or the usual suspects after this. Anything you see posted late counts as campaigning, so note the time, check the source, and wait for VeloResults. Verify before you forward. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight. The Commission says parties and media stop campaigning until polls close. Forwarded voice notes telling us to stay home tomorrow? Ignore them. Check the official notices and VeloResults. Vote with the facts, not the chain. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight, and Chirp is somehow still full of 'BREAKING' threads. Singer endorsement video + 'danger to our children' with zero context? Sure. Silence means silence, people. Maybe sit this one out and check the official results portal instead. #VeloriaVotes
Campaign silence starts tonight, so no more pitches. Before polls close, check the costings and the VeloResults setup yourself. Procedure beats the chain messages. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7 and the silence starts tonight. Still no costings from either camp, just chain voice notes. Don't stay home on a WhatsApp say-so, check the official Commission site and VeloResults first. Who's actually backing the road budget numbers? #VeloriaVotes

Election day, polls open. Before anyone shares a 'stay home' voice note or a 'results are in' screenshot, check the Commission's own notices and VeloResults. Vote on the facts. Both camps still owe us real road-budget costings. #VeloriaVotes

Election day in Veloria. Polls are open. Some ID kits failed up north, and the Commission switched to the printed register like the law allows. Check VeloResults and the IECV site, not the chain. Vote, then wait for the official count. #VeloriaVotes

Election day in Veloria. Polls are open and the Commission says turnout is high. Some ID kits failed in the Northern Province and officials switched to the printed register, which the law allows. Check your polling station on the official IECV site before you go. Results go on VeloResults. Verify first, then forward. #VeloriaVotes

Polls are open. Got my ID check done, the printed register worked fine at my station. If you're voting today, go with the official notices and VeloResults, not the chain messages. Vote your own view, from your own facts. #VeloriaVotes

Election day in Veloria. Some ID kits failed up north and the Commission switched to the printed register, as the law allows. Check what's actually official on the IECV site and VeloResults before you believe a chain about ballot boxes. Vote, then verify. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8, polls open. Some voter-ID kits failed up north and officials switched to the printed register, as the law allows. Before you forward the 'pre-stuffed boxes' photo, check the IECV notice and VeloResults. Vote, then verify. #VeloriaVotes

Election day in Veloria and the polls are open. Printed register instead of the ID kits in the north is fine by the law. Results go on VeloResults, not the chain. Vote, then check the forms. #VeloriaVotes

Election day in Veloria. Polls are open, and the Commission says some ID kits failed in the Northern Province, so they switched to the printed register as the law allows. Check VeloResults and the IECV site, not the chain. Vote, then wait for the forms. #VeloriaVotes

Polls are still open and the 'FINAL RESULTS' thread from @IECV_Results is not from the Commission. Kito and VBC tallies disagree because they count different stations first. Nobody has the final count yet. Wait for VeloResults. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9 and two tallies, Kito at 51-47 Arden and VBC at 53-45 Ostrand, each counting different stations first. Neither is a result. Someone posted 'FINAL' from an unverified account and it's trending. Wait for VeloResults. Don't share numbers you can't source. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9 and somehow Chirp has 'FINAL RESULTS: Ostrand 54.2%' from an account with no verification, while Kito and VBC are arguing over stations counted in different orders. Nobody has official numbers yet. Wait for VeloResults, not @IECV_Results lol #VeloriaVotes

Day 9 and the two Kito/VBC tallies flip the lead: Arden 51 vs Ostrand 53. Different station samples, so neither is the result. Count the forms on VeloResults, not the screenshots. Note to self: wait for the official count before I believe anyone. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8, polls open. Two tallies out of Kito TV: Arden 51-47 on 30% of stations, VBC has Ostrand 53-45 on 25%. Different stations counted first, so neither is a result. Wait for VeloResults and the official count. #VeloriaVotes

Kito says Arden 51, VBC says Ostrand 53. Different stations counted first, so neither proves anything yet. Also saw the Civic Front page calling it a WIN for Arden and asking Ostrand to concede. Based on what, exactly? Show the tallies. Wait for VeloResults. #VeloriaVotes

Two tallies, opposite leads: Kito's 51-47 Arden on 30% of stations, VBC's 53-45 Ostrand on 25%. Different stations counted first, so neither is a result yet. Wait for VeloResults and the full count before reading anything into it. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9, and we're already at 'Arden 51' vs 'Ostrand 53' on two different tallies. Two polls, two sets of stations counted first. Wait for VeloResults before anyone tells you who won. Patience, like rain, comes in its own time. #VeloriaVotes
Two tallies, two different sets of stations counted first. Kito and VBC can't both be the result. Stop screenshotting numbers and wait for the full VeloResults count. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9 and still no official count. 41% of forms online, portal glitch, Kito says Arden 51, VBC says Ostrand 53. Different stations counted first, so neither proves anything. Both camps owe us road budget costings too. Wait for VeloResults. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9 and the Commission still has 41% of forms up. Kito and VBC tallies point opposite ways, so neither tells us anything yet. Also, Ostrand's road-budget costings still haven't been shown. Who backs those numbers? Show the work. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10. VeloResults still only has 41% of station forms, and the Commission says it's a technical glitch. Kito's 51-47 and VBC's 53-45 are still two different samples. A 'FINAL' screenshot is not a final count. Wait for the full collation, then talk. Patience, like rain, comes in its own time. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9, and the portal is still 41% of forms. The '9 of 14 provinces' claim has been fact-checked as FALSE by VeriCheck. Nobody can call a winner from 41% of stations. Wait for VeloResults. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10 and VeloResults is still at 41% of forms, Patriots Daily says it 'PROVES' Arden won 9 of 14 provinces. Proves what? The portal's down. Show me the forms or it's just vibes. Wait for the official count. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10 and VeloResults is still at 41% because of a 'technical glitch'. Both tallies are partial and disagree. Nobody has a count yet. Just wait for the official numbers, folks. Traffic jam outside Kito TV btw lol #VeloriaVotes

Two tallies, opposite leads: Kito's 51-47 Arden on 30% of stations, VBC's 53-45 Ostrand on 25%. Different stations counted first, so neither is a result. The Commission portal is missing 59% of forms. Before anyone claims a win or asks for a concession, let's see the full count on VeloResults. Also still waiting on real road-budget costings from both camps. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11 and the Commission finally says Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, turnout 68%. Official count, on VeloResults. Funny how the 'FINAL' screenshots from Day 9 never looked like this. Show the forms next time, Kito & VBC. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. The Commission has declared it: Ostrand 50.6%, Arden 47.9%, turnout 68%. Official count, from the IECV. Kito and VBC's partial tallies can rest now. Patience, like rain, comes in its own time, and today it came. Congratulations to Mara Ostrand, and thanks to the poll workers who kept the forms moving. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. The Commission has declared Ostrand re-elected, 50.6 to 47.9. Results are out, and I'm glad it's settled, but I hope both sides now show their road-budget costings like they promised. Health staffing is what I care about. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11: the IECV has declared Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to Arden's 47.9%, turnout 68%. Observers say voting was orderly but the state broadcaster was skewed and transmission delays hurt confidence. Those are worth discussing. Check the declaration on the IECV site before sharing numbers. #VeloriaVotes

Commission says Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, turnout 68%. Official notice is on IECV, not the chain. Those two partial tallies were never the count. Ask questions about the forms if you have them. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11 and the Commission says Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9. Civic Front says 'manipulated' and says they're going to court. Fine, take it to the Supreme Court. But show the forms, not a 'we reject' line. Which stations, which numbers? Same people who said 'WIN' on day 9 with 41% in. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11 and the Commission has declared Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to 47.9%. The observers flagged skewed state coverage and transmission delays, so I want the full forms on VeloResults before I read anything into the margin. Concession speeches can wait for the audit. Wait for the official count. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11 and the Commission has declared it: Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to Arden's 47.9%, turnout 68%. Official count is in on VeloResults. Congrats to Mara's team, and to Tomas on running a real campaign. Now let's get back to fixing the roads. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12 and VBC is showing burning tyres as 'opposition riots' while Kito has the Supreme Court ordering access to the servers. Ok so the official count is out, but the court fight is where I want to see the logs. Who's actually looking at them? #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Kito says the Civic Front petition is heading to the Supreme Court, which ordered supervised access to the commission's servers and logs. Good. Let the audit run, and let's see whether the forms match the declared 50.6-47.9. Show the work, both sides. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Kito says the Civic Front petition is going to court, and the Supreme Court wants both sides to get supervised access to the servers and logs. Good. That's how it should work. Let them look at the forms. Patience, like rain, comes in its own time. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. VBC shows burning tyres and calls it a riot. Kito says the court just ordered supervised access to the servers and logs. Okay, let's see what the logs say. Official count's already out and I'm happy to read the audit. Roads still need fixing though. #VeloriaVotes

Court filing from the Civic Front and a Supreme Court order for supervised access to the server logs. Good. That's how a disputed result gets checked. Let the audit run and let the logs speak. #VeloriaVotes
Day 12 and a court order to open the servers to both sides. Good. Now show the forms, then we can all stop guessing. Also still waiting on real road-budget costings. Let's see the work. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11 and the Commission has declared Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9. Civic Front is going to court over 'manipulation' but where are the forms? Name the stations and the numbers. The state broadcaster's coverage was skewed, so fair questions about that are fair. Just show the evidence, not vibes. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11 and the Commission has declared it: Ostrand 50.6%, Arden 47.9%, turnout 68%. That's the official count on VeloResults. Kito's 51-47 and VBC's 53-45 were partial tallies from different stations, so they never told us anything. Congrats to Mara Ostrand. Now I'd like both camps to publish the road-budget costings they promised. #VeloriaVotes
